title: Stress-Testing Image Classifiers Under Realistic Distribution Shift
description: A benchmark of 40 natural distribution shifts showing that robustness rankings on synthetic corruptions do not transfer to real deployments.

title: Elastic Checkpointing for Preemptible Distributed Training
conference: Workshop on Efficient Example Systems @ ECLS 2025
description: Checkpoints that adapt their frequency to the preemption rate of spot instances, cutting lost GPU hours by 35% in our cluster traces.

title: Repairing Shape Errors in Deep Learning Code with Static Analysis
description: A static analyzer that finds tensor shape mismatches in training scripts and proposes one-line fixes, repairing 61% of bugs in a new dataset.

title: Flaky Tests in Distributed ML Pipelines
description: An empirical look at why tests of distributed training code fail intermittently, and which fixes developers apply.
